name: MyOS Session Subscription Update
description: Provider-mediated subscription update for one logical source document. The same subscriptionId is used for the root source and derived linked-document streams. sourceInitialDocument identifies the logical document represented by this update.

subscriptionId.description: Stable identifier of the subscription stream.

sourceInitialDocument.description: Initial document identifying the logical source of this update.

document.description: Optional processed source-document snapshot selected by the filter.

events.description: Matching emitted events for the delivered source epoch; may be empty.
